issues.description: Function detect_errors: return type is inconsistent between artifacts. The problem statement and reference solution declare detect_errors(measurements: npt.NDArray[np.int8], checks: npt.NDArray[np.int8]) -> npt.NDArray[np.int8], i.e. it should return a numpy array of int8 indicating which shots are good. The template repository's msd.py declares the same function but with return annotation -> list[int] while its docstring describes returning an npt.NDArray[np.int8]. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and how to use the function's output with downstream code that expects numpy arrays (e.g. matrix multiplication and boolean indexing).
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template function signature in template_repository/msd.py to match the problem statement and solution: change the return annotation from -> list[int] to -> npt.NDArray[np.int8] and adjust the docstring return type text to npt.NDArray[np.int8]. This keeps the API consistent and ensures students implement and return a numpy int8 array compatible with the rest of the provided code.
